body.statement: Fix \(z=(u,v)\in D\) and \(\theta\in[\theta_L,\theta_U]\). On \([\max(0,\Delta),\min(p_1,1-p_0)]\), the equation \[(\theta-1)b^2+\{1-(\theta-1)\Delta\}b-p_1(1-p_0)=0\] has exactly one root, namely \(b_{\theta}(z)\) from \(\mathrm{def:compatible-root}\), and its four masses from \(\mathrm{def:attaining-law}\) are nonnegative and satisfy \(p_{11}p_{00}=\theta p_{10}p_{01}\).
body.justification: A unique probability-compatible branch prevents algebraic root selection from contaminating sharpness.
body.gap: ZhangNieSoonLiu2013, Section 3.3, reconstructs a positive \(2\times2\) table at fixed clean margins; this lemma includes structural-zero margins created at assay-feasibility contacts.
body.consumer: The selected branch is the evaluable objective for certified endpoint enumeration.
